ledger.x: 302: Yuwen Mogui claims the chanyu title.

wars.name: Yuwen-Murong wars
wars.outcome: Mogui's 302 attack on the Murong was repelled; Xiduguan allied with Cui Bi to attack them in 319; Murong Huang fought the Yuwen 'in 320 and 325' (Murong Hui page); Yidougui backed Murong Ren in the 333 civil war and fought Huang after 336; in 338 the Yuwen…

wars.name: Conquest of the Yuwen
wars.outcome: Murong Huang destroyed the Yuwen power base at Zimengchuan, annexed the domain and moved over 5,000 tribes to Changli.

certainty.note: A tribal polity known by its capital and a one-line regional description; no frontier on any page.
